entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Praveen Tripathi,Shakti Krishna Chaube
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Praveen Tripathi, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Akhilesh Kumar
Vyas, the learned Additional Government Advocate appearing on behalf of the State and perused the
records.

2. The instant application has been filed by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R. bearing
Case Crime No.065 of 2022, under Sections 60 (1) and 72 of Excise Act & Sections 419, 420, 467,
468, 471 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Tikait Nagar, District Barabanki.

3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 24.02.2022 stating that on the basis of an information received from a mukhbir two persons riding a motorcycle were intercepted.
It is alleged that one person escaped and the co-accused Kamlu was apprehended and some illicit liquor was recovered from his possession.
In his custodial statement the co-accused Kamlu has stated that the person who had escaped was the applicant.

4. In the affidavit filed in support of the anticipatory bail-application it has been contended that the applicant is innocent, he has no criminal history and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.

sentences.text: 5. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant has been implicated in the present case solely on the basis of custodial statement of the co-accused and no incriminating material has been recovered from the applicant coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and without making any observations which may affect the outcome of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for granting anticipatory bail to the applicant.
7. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.

In the event of arrest/ appearance of applicant-Ramu Alias Raj Kumar before the learned Trial Court in the aforesaid case crime, he shall be released on anticipatory bail on his furnishing personal bond and two solvent sureties, each in the like amount, to the satisfaction of S.H.O./Court concerned on the following conditions and subject to any other conditions that may be fixed by the Trial Court:
(i). That the applicant shall appear before the trial court on each date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted;
(ii). That the applicant shall not, directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence;
(iii). That the applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
Order Date :- 19.9.2023 Ram.
